scope: Vulkan on NVIDIA RTX 2060 SUPER, not Intel hardware; offline native benchmark, not production BOINC quorum or image acceptance
native_engine_identity_note: image is deployed native executable SHA; llama is native llama.lock digest (release-level identity shared by backends), not equality of backend binaries. Both executable/build receipts must be retained separately. No output/manifest metadata will be rewritten for comparison.
native_image_field_note: This native-only benchmark uses the native executable SHA in engine.image, not an OCI registry image digest; do not treat it as a production image-validator receipt.

cuda.build_banner_note: Source archive has no Git metadata and build container has no Git; source identity is the pinned tag commit and archive SHA above, not the uninformative build banner.

inference.execution: native inside CT214 with two CPU threads; no new cgroup constraints or GPU/runtime settings
inference.order: CUDA, interrupted/discarded Vulkan, 15-minute shared-task yield, fresh full Vulkan
inference.caches: No shared or private shader/filesystem cache was cleared. No cold-disk or cold-shader-cache claim.
inference.discarded_pass_note: First Vulkan pass yielded to a newly executing unrelated CPU quality BOINC task after 75 complete readings. Its own worker was terminated and server shut down; GPU idle verified at 21:40:43 UTC. Published Vulkan scores/timing use a new uninterrupted 100-crop pass only.

comparison.implementation: usnm-boinc qwen compare, the implementation invoked by usnm_qwen_compare; raw manifests/readings/diagnostics are validated first
comparison.manifest_filenames: Byte-identical result.json copies named cuda_JOB_result / vulkan_JOB_result satisfy the validator upload-name logging policy. No job/engine/result metadata was rewritten. Copies are retained in native/validator-upload-names in the raw archive.
comparison.exact_match_semantics: Exact equality of normal worker clean_reading output strings; whitespace-equal additionally collapses Unicode whitespace runs and trims ends.
comparison.cer_delta_convention: Vulkan minus CUDA, per crop, percentage points; aggregate CER is edit-weighted, not the mean crop CER.

energy_estimate.method: Mean sampled reported GPU-board watts times completed-pass wall seconds / 100 crops, scaled to 12000 crops; excludes host draw, build/setup and discarded/yielded attempt. Not wall-meter power.

limitations: This does not validate Intel Iris Xe or Arc hardware, cross-vendor agreement, production image b11610, independent-host quorum, Windows CUDA, or operator rollout.
The historical #849 CUDA production-image result (2.137% legacy CER) is not this source-built native b8799 pair.
The native CUDA build is source-pinned for this experiment; Linux CUDA is not a prebuilt asset in llama.lock.
Native engine identities were staged once before either pass. The common lock digest denotes the native source release family, not identical backend executable bytes.
